definitions.explanation: Paying money to make up for loss or damage one has caused. Typically used when someone breaks, loses, or damages another person's property.

examples.japanese: ⟦{壊|こわ}した→壊す：01241_kowasu⟧もの⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{弁償|べんしょう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please pay for what you broke.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧なくしてしまい、{弁償|べんしょう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I lost my friend's book and paid to replace it.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{店|みせ}→お店：21164_omise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}として→落とす：01246_otosu⟧⟦{割|わ}って→割る：02334_waru⟧しまった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{弁償|べんしょう}⟦しなくて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: I dropped and broke a product in the store, but they told me I didn't have to pay for it.

notes:
The verb form {弁償|べんしょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ means "to compensate" or "to pay for damages." This is a practical word that comes up in everyday situations — borrowing and losing things, accidentally breaking items, etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {弁償|べんしょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to compensate, to pay for)
- {弁償|べんしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧ (to demand compensation)
- {弁償|べんしょう}{金|きん} (compensation money)
- ⟦{全額|ぜんがく}→全額：16829_zengaku⟧{弁償|べんしょう} (full reimbursement)

More everyday than the legal term ⟦{賠償|ばいしょう}→賠償：07641_baishou⟧ (damages/reparations), which is used in formal legal contexts. {弁償|べんしょう} is what you say when you break your friend's vase; ⟦{賠償|ばいしょう}→賠償：07641_baishou⟧ is what a lawyer says in court.
